metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,071 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly a table name the schema spells differently and GROUP BY positions that name aggregates). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. Measured on master 7b7ba13 (harness translation #347, HAVING-only wider search #356); prover rules merged later (cast_rules.py and after) are not rerun yet. VeriEQL refutes pair 21215 without a replayable counterexample; read by hand, it is equivalent (GROUP BY 1 vs GROUP BY the key, IS NOT NULL on the primary key). 2026-10-04: 6 proofs fewer (4,793 to 4,787): the parser check refuses the pairs whose MySQL text uses `||` as OR (MySQL's default reading; sqlglot reads concatenation), found by re-running the 17 pairs it refuses on master and on this branch, not by a full rerun (docs/parser-checks.md). 2026-11-12 (commit 97e4a0e, whole corpus in six chunks of 4,000 with --audit, 0 wrong): 4,787 to 9,022 proved. The gain is not all from one change: it includes every prover rule merged since 2026-10-02 and the harness fixes (two primary keys, consecutive ids), which were not measured one by one. Measured on the problems this batch worked on, before and after its rules on the same base (prover only, so every pair of the problem): 1084 9 to 178 of 918; 614 96 to 340 of 544; 1677 0 to 282 of 437; 1587 475 to 531 of 774; 182 84 to 150 of 265; 1809 192 to 496 of 575; 1468 85 to 97 of 670; 1715 178 to 179 of 442; 585, 183, 1045, 1173, 1435 and 1783 unchanged. Every newly proved pair of those problems (1,134 of them, measured on the batch's earlier commit) was re-checked by the harness, which searches 1,000 further databases: all equivalent or unknown because DuckDB rejects the query, none wrong. Many unproven pairs of these problems agree with the reference on every database tried but differ on a NULL the generated databases never contain (a nullable foreign key or CHECK column); they stay unknown. The refuted count fell from 5,676 to 5,129 since 2026-10-02 (see verieql-leetcode-executed); the cause was not separated. After main moved again, the merged commit e7ad6b7 was checked on every 24th pair (1,000 pairs): the same 384 proved, 208 refuted, 364 agree, 44 not run as in the whole run on 97e4a0e, 0 wrong. The rest of the corpus was not rerun on e7ad6b7. 2026-11-16 (string-literal checks): the 883 pairs the change reaches were run on the base and on the change, not the whole corpus. None lost a proof; 12 that agreed on every database are now proved (9 development, 3 held out), each through the harness's 1,000-database recheck, because a declared DATE column compared with two date strings is no longer sent through the numeric reading. They are not added to the count above, which stays the whole run on 97e4a0e. 2026-11-18 (truth values read as 1 or 0, issue 42): a scan of the pairs that compare a truth value with something (929 pairs of every eval with an adapter, the 490 LeetCode pairs among them) was run on the base and on the change, not the whole corpus. None lost a proof; 39 LeetCode pairs that agreed on every database are now proved (13 held out), each through the harness's 1,000-database recheck and the near-miss probe. They are not added to the count above, which stays the whole run on 97e4a0e. 2026-11-18 (the 2026-11-11 worker rules merged with main f6585e0, commit 0779faa; whole corpus in twelve slices of 2,000 with --audit, the base side being main eaf4899 measured the same way on 2026-11-17, 0 wrong): 9,113 to 10,891 proved (+1,778, none lost, 0 wrong; refuted unchanged at 5,129). This count includes the 12 pairs and the 39 pairs of the two notes above (they were counted separately before). Main f6585e0 itself (hardest-cases batches 4 to 7 and the truth-value fix) was not run on the whole LeetCode set, so the gain over it is not known pair by pair: the same branch before batches 6 and 7 (commit e75c9a3) had 10,848, and the merge with them adds 43 proofs, none lost. The new proofs are the rules of docs/evals/verieql.md (2026-11-17); the harness gave every one of them equivalent. 2026-11-18 (MySQL rounds a quotient or AVG a derived table stores, Kumo_SQL_Prover issue 45): a scan of every pair of every eval with an adapter (55,203 pairs) found the 764 whose queries read such a value from a materialising derived table or CTE; they were proved on main fab9ed0 (the 10,891 above) and on the change, not the whole corpus. Nine proofs are removed: 6589 and 20662, 20667, 20737, 20803, 20851, 20944, 21031, 21224 (the LeetCode problem that reports each manager's average age: `ROUND(AVG(TB2.AGE), 0)` directly against `ROUND(M.AVG_AGE, 0)` over a grouped derived table or CTE's `AVG(AGE)`; 6589 is the same shape with `ROUND(.., 2)`). They were false proofs in MySQL, shown on MySQL 8.0.46 with made-up tables: 202 rows with one 1 give `0.00` directly and `0.01` through the derived table, 10,001 rows with 5,000 ones give `0` and `1` for `ROUND(.., 0)`. The generated databases are too small to show it, so the executed search reports them as agreeing. 10,891 to 10,882; nothing was gained; 678 of the scanned pairs are VeriEQL pairs and the other scanned proofs (`ROUND(AVG(..))` with no digits, which is exact) stay proved. 2026-11-19 (the tenth hardest-cases batch, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 48: shares and percentages): not in the count. The whole set was not rerun; every 24th pair (1,000) was, on c7d7021: 470 proved against 463 on 873f667. The earlier whole run (0779faa, 2026-11-18) had 10,891; PR 46 removed nine proofs (10,882) and the batches 10 to 15 (PRs 48, 50, 51, 52, 53) came after it, so +635 against the recorded 10,882. The two were not measured apart and the gain was not measured batch by batch on the whole corpus (the 1,000-pair samples of each batch gained 7, 8, 9, 2 and 1). Against the recorded run the refuted column is one pair lower (5,129) and the not-run column one lower (1,072), the agree column 633 lower (6,911); the move of those two single pairs was not separated (no per-pair record of the earlier run, and the harness changed in between how a search the time budget interrupts is recorded, PR 51). Every 24th pair of this run: 490 proved, 208 refuted, 258 agree, 44 not run, as the 490 measured on ad089f6. Audit against VeriEQL's published outcomes: no proof contradicts a counterexample that replays on DuckDB (0 wrong). 66 proved pairs are marked NEQ by VeriEQL without a counterexample it ships (all LeetCode problem 1731, the manager average age with `ROUND(AVG(age), 0)`, the family of the 21215 note above; 12 of them were proved before the worker rules, the 54 others since); they are read as exact because `ROUND(AVG(..), 0)` keeps the integer an average produces whichever way it is stored, and no counterexample replays. Main moved during the run: Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 55 (the sixteenth batch, main 3c25389) was merged while it ran, so this count is not on main. The batch's rules reach the pairs of one problem (cases 15916 to 16269); cases 15900 to 16299 (400 pairs) were run on 3c25389 with the same command and compared with the slice on 56376ef: 57 pairs went from agreeing to proved (46 development, 11 held out), none changed any other way, 0 wrong, so the batch is not in the 11,517 and a whole run on 3c25389 would hold about 11,574 proofs if the rest of the corpus is unmoved (not measured). A whole run of this size takes about 5.5 hours; the per-slice dumps are kept with the project files.
held_out: Every fifth pair (index % 5 == 0, 4,799 pairs) was never read while writing the 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 VeriEQL rules (join_distinct_aggregates, keyed_group_filters, key_group_choice, duplicate_values, anti_membership_joins, and the earlier aggregate_membership, rank_filters, extreme_joins, extreme_rows, keyed_lookups); 1,789 of its pairs are proved (37.3%) against 7,233 of the other 19,195 (37.7%). Search settings were tuned on every 24th pair (1,000) in October; those overlap both groups. On 2026-11-18 the held-out pairs of the 2026-11-11 worker rules (1783, 1468, 614, 1045, 1809, 182, 183) were never read either: in the whole run 2,146 of the 4,799 held-out pairs are proved (44.7%) against 8,745 of the other 19,195 (45.6%), and the branch gained 338 held-out proofs against 1,440 development ones (main eaf4899: 1,808 held out). 2026-11-22 (whole run on 56376ef, counts only): 2,274 of the 4,799 held-out pairs are proved (47.4%) against 9,243 of the other 19,195 (48.2%); the held-out pairs were never read.
